claude.sample_unit: ICU stays (3,692 training, 1,582 MIMIC-IV internal test, 1,801 eICU-CRD external)

links.outcome: Calibration slope after local updating (offset-only, recalibration learning curve) in eICU
links.effect: Offset-only updating retained a slope of 0.437. At 125 events, same-system median out-of-sample slope was 0.877, but hospital-held-out slope was 0.789 (38.4% within 0.8–1.2).
links.quote: Offset-only updating retained a slope of 0.437.

links.outcome: Calibration performance across hospitals in eICU-CRD
links.effect: Hospital-held-out slope was 0.789 (38.4% within 0.8–1.2), and only 2 of 67 hospitals had at least 10 events.
links.quote: additional pooled events did not correct unseen-hospital transport, and no single-hospital threshold was estimable.

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of frozen model on external database vs internal test
links.effect: AUROC 0.768 internally and 0.746 externally; external calibration-in-the-large −0.712 (overprediction) with slope 0.446.
links.quote: The model retained cross-database discrimination but not calibrated absolute risk.

links.effect: Internal calibration slope 1.501 (under-dispersed) despite CITL 0.007; external CITL −0.712 with slope 0.446; external AUROC 0.746.
links.quote: Mean overprediction (calibration-in-the-large − 0.712) occurred with a slope of 0.446.

Recalibration learning curve to estimate events needed for local updating

models_evaluated: LASSO logistic model for near-term documented vasopressin treatment signal

links.effect: External AUROC 0.746; mean overprediction calibration-in-the-large − 0.712; slope 0.446.
links.quote: Mean overprediction (calibration-in-the-large − 0.712) occurred with a slope of 0.446.

links.effect: Internal AUROC 0.768; external AUROC 0.746; external calibration-in-the-large − 0.712 with slope 0.446.
links.quote: The model retained cross-database discrimination but not calibrated absolute risk.

links.effect: Median slope 0.877 same-system vs 0.789 hospital-held-out; 93.6% vs 38.4% within 0.8–1.2.
links.quote: At the largest same-system target of 125 events, median out-of-sample slope was 0.877 (93.6% of repetitions within 0.8–1.2); hospital-held-out slope was 0.789 (38.4% within 0.8–1.2), and only 2 of 67 hospitals had at least 10 events.

links.outcome: calibration and discrimination after cross-database transfer
links.effect: AUROC was preserved (0.746 externally vs 0.768 internally), but calibration failed with mean overprediction (calibration-in-the-large -0.712) and slope 0.446 (vs internal slope 1.501, calibration-in-the-large 0.007).
links.quote: The model retained cross-database discrimination but not calibrated absolute risk.

links.effect: Internally, calibration-in-the-large was 0.007 with slope 1.501, but externally calibration-in-the-large was -0.712 with slope 0.446, reflecting opposite calibration errors and marked overprediction.
links.quote: Internally, mean predicted risk was aligned (calibration-in-the-large 0.007), but a slope of 1.501 indicated under-dispersed predictions; externally, the calibration errors were opposite in direction.

links.outcome: recalibration slope across sample sizes and hospitals
links.effect: Median slope was 0.877 (93.6% within 0.8–1.2) at 125 same-system events, but hospital-held-out slope was 0.789 (38.4% within 0.8–1.2), and only 2 of 67 hospitals had >=10 events.
links.quote: At the largest same-system target of 125 events, median out-of-sample slope was 0.877 (93.6% of repetitions within 0.8–1.2); hospital-held-out slope was 0.789 (38.4% within 0.8–1.2), and only 2 of 67 hospitals had at least 10 events.
